function.name: FADE_MUSIC_OFF
function.param: Time to shutdown the music in miliseconds
function.abstract: Stop the music lowering the volume gradually

description.p: This function stops the music that is playing currently (the music will be initialized for the function ) lowering gradually the volume until the music shutdowns. The parameter miliseconds indicated the approximatted time in which the music will stop to be listened.

Obviously after calling to this function, the music will not have finalized inmediatly. To know when it is secure to use or play other music, it is necessary to use to check if the music has finalized his reproduction.
